prop1.title: Győrszentiván Industrial & Agricultural Land
features: 46 ha licensed gravel pit with rail siding
prop1.description: Strategically located industrial and agricultural land in Győrszentiván, just 1 km from the M1 highway. The complex includes a 10,300 m² developed industrial facility, 107 hectares of high-quality arable land, and a 46-hectare licensed gravel quarry with a direct railway connection.

prop2.title: Nagycenk Senior Living & Healthcare Center
prop2.description: Premium senior living and healthcare complex in Nagycenk at 75% completion. Set in a 1.7-hectare mature tree park, the 6,284 m² building can be completed turnkey in approximately 8 months. Features 56 senior care units, 18 upgraded apartments, private wellness section, and healthcare block.

prop3.title: Szentendre Pap Island Thermal Resort
prop3.location: Szentendre, Pap Island (20 km from Budapest)
features: private 1,850 m deep thermal well (50°C, 1,500 L/min yield)
prop3.description: Unique Danube waterfront tourism and wellness development opportunity on Pap Island in Szentendre. The 3.5-hectare private estate features its own 1,850m deep thermal well yielding 50°C water at 1,500 liters/minute. Located just 20 km from Budapest.

prop4.title: Keszthely Balaton Residential Park Project
features: Nearly 1 ha Lake Balaton waterfront plot
complete underground garage and elevator shafts
prop4.description: Prime development plot of nearly 1 hectare directly near Lake Balaton in Keszthely. Features a structurally completed 42-apartment luxury condominium frame with underground parking, elevator shafts, and approved architectural plans.

prop5.title: Truck Park & Logistics Terminal (M5)
prop5.description: International truck park and logistics terminal adjacent to the M5 highway in the Hungarian-Serbian border region. The 6.66-hectare fenced industrial plot accommodates up to 370 trucks simultaneously, complete with TIR service bay, driver motel, and a 200-seat restaurant.

prop6.title: Keszthely Vt-8 Commercial Development Plot
features: 17,943 m² contiguous area at southern access road
100% clean SPV (Share Deal) with penalty coverage guarantee
prop6.description: 17,943 m² contiguous commercial development plot located along Keszthely's southern access road. Vt-8 zoning with 50-75% buildability, ideal for hypermarkets or retail parks. Offered via 100% clean SPV Share Deal with contractual penalty coverage.

prop7.title: Hotel die Traube (Admont, Austria)
prop7.description: Operational traditional hotel and hospitality complex in Admont, Styria (Austria). Unencumbered property offered together with a 100% Austrian GmbH. Seller offers an immediate long-term leaseback and management guarantee upon request.

prop8.title: Balaton Wellness Park & Resort (Gyenesdiás)
features: 2,300 m² built structure (10 apartments, restaurant, wellness)
prop8.description: 49,000 m² wellness park and resort complex located in Gyenesdiás. Features 2,300 m² of high-end structures (10 equipped apartments, restaurant, wellness area), accompanied by a fully serviced 100-pitch premium RV/camper park.

prop9.title: Balatongyörök Golf Course & Waterfront Property

operational 18-hole championship golf course with beach & clubhouse
prop9.description: Rare 72-hectare direct Lake Balaton waterfront property in Balatongyörök. Includes an operational 18-hole championship golf course built to international standards, private beach, clubhouse, and panoramic restaurant, with marina and apartment park expansion potential.

MobileHome.title: Containerized Mobile Homes & Regional Expansion
MobileHome.subtitle: High-quality, container-transportable modular living spaces (30 sqm, 50 sqm, 80-100 sqm) equipped with self-sustaining solar systems, optimized for European export and African regional assembly.
MobileHome.feature1Desc: Quick and simple installation worldwide using standard marine container logistics.
MobileHome.feature2Desc: Utilizing local workforce in West African (Abidjan) and Southern African (Lusaka) assembly hubs.
MobileHome.feature3Desc: Highly optimized shipping volume of flat-packed modular units assembled locally.
MobileHome.b2bTitle: Strategic and Financial Benefits for Manufacturing Partners
MobileHome.b2bSubtitle: The logistics and assembly franchise structure of HOMLAMENTOR KFT provides direct financial and competitive advantages in international markets.
MobileHome.b2bCard1Desc: Exporting finished houses from Europe is uncompetitive due to immense shipping rates. By importing flat-packed containerized systems for local assembly at the HOMLAMENTOR KFT hub, 100% of the logistics savings convert straight into net operational profit.
MobileHome.b2bCard2Desc: Utilizing the highly trained local labor force at the Abidjan/Ivory Coast logistics and distribution center reduces assembly and manufacturing wage costs by 50%.
MobileHome.b2bCard3Desc: Local manufacturing and assembly entities established in West Africa enjoy special corporate tax exemptions (tax holidays) and regional custom duty benefits under free trade agreements (ECOWAS).
